fields.System.Title: INB-104 — Receive an ASN from the ERP automatically
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk, I want ASNs to arrive from the ERP without anyone typing them, so
that expectations are accurate and up to date.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a valid ERP message, when it is processed, then an ASN is created.
  • - Given the same message replayed, then one ASN exists, not two.
  • - Given a message referencing an unknown product, then it is rejected with a clear
  • reason and moved to the dead-letter store.
  • - Given an updated ASN for an existing reference, then the existing ASN is amended if it
  • has not been received against.
  • - Given any rejected message, then the original payload is retained for review.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, platform |
| Tables | asn, asn_line, dead-letter |
| Risks | Duplicate from retry ([doc 09 §3.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); silent drop ([doc 08 §6](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration · idempotency |
